CORRESPONDENCE - RIVERA / RIVER OAK UNIFIED SCHOOL
DISTRICT
From: Dana Rivera To: Marcus Ellison Date: December 2, 2025 Subject: Request for reevaluation -
Jordan Rivera
Dear Mr. Ellison, I am requesting in writing a reevaluation of Jordan's reading skills, including a full
assessment of his phonological processing and decoding. His progress report of November 14, 2025
shows 21 words per minute, which is below where he started in August. Please send me the assessment
plan. Thank you, Dana Rivera
From: Marcus Ellison To: Dana Rivera Date: December 4, 2025 Subject: RE: Request for
reevaluation - Jordan Rivera
Ms. Rivera, thank you for your request. The District will prepare an assessment plan for your consent
within the required timeline. Regards, Marcus Ellison
From: Dana Rivera To: Marcus Ellison Date: March 14, 2026 Subject: Request to revise reading
goal - Jordan Rivera
Dear Mr. Ellison, following the meeting on March 12, I am requesting in writing that Jordan's reading
fluency goal be revised based on his current level, and that the District provide the assessment plan I
requested on December 2, 2025, which I have not received. Please respond in writing. Dana Rivera
From: Dana Rivera To: Marcus Ellison Date: April 2, 2026 Subject: RE: Request to revise reading
goal - Jordan Rivera
Mr. Ellison, I have not received a response to my March 14 request, and I still have not received an
assessment plan. Dana Rivera
